description: Reasoning Schemas & Problem-Solving Archetypes for Decimals, Place Value Rounding, Four Arithmetic Operations, Fraction Conversions, Unit Prices, and Statistical Means.

archetypes.name: Decimal Positional Rounding & Threshold Test (การปัดเศษทศนิยมตามตำแหน่งที่กำหนด)
archetypes.coreConcept: Rounding a decimal to a target positional scale based on whether the decisive subsequent digit is >= 5.
mentalModel: 1. Identify the target rounding place value digit.
2. Inspect the test digit immediately to the right.
3. If test digit >= 5 round up target digit; otherwise keep target digit unchanged and truncate trailing digits.

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding the rounding base directly or truncating without rounding up.

versatileDomains.description: Rounding optical density absorbance values for clinical reporting.
Rounding milling depth offsets to nearest hundredth millimeter.

archetypes.name: Columnar Decimal Alignment & Addition (การตั้งบวกทศนิยมตรงตำแหน่งจุด)
archetypes.coreConcept: Aligning decimal addends strictly by their decimal point ensures proper place value positional summation.
mentalModel: 1. Line up addends vertically matching decimal points.
2. Pad trailing zero place values if necessary.
3. Add columns from right to left carrying tens across place boundaries.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting instead of adding, or misaligning columns.

versatileDomains.description: Summing grocery item price receipts at point of sale.
Summing vertical benchmark elevation offsets.

archetypes.name: Decimal Subtraction with Zero-Padded Regrouping (การลบทศนิยมแบบเติมศูนย์และกระจายหลัก)
archetypes.coreConcept: Padding minuend with trailing zeros allows systematic column borrowing when subtracting decimals of unequal lengths.
mentalModel: 1. Align decimal points vertically.
2. Append zeros to minuend to match precision depth.
3. Execute regrouping and column subtraction.

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding terms together instead of subtracting with regrouping.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating net reagent mass by subtracting tare beaker mass from gross mass.
Computing net fuel batch delivery from initial and final meter readings.

archetypes.name: Decimal Multiplication & Positional Point Placement (การคูณทศนิยมและการนับตำแหน่งจุด)
archetypes.coreConcept: Multiplying factors as integers, then setting decimal places equal to the sum of decimal places in all factors.
mentalModel: 1. Multiply factors ignoring decimal points.
2. Count total decimal places across all factor terms.
3. Insert decimal point counting from right to left in product.
archetypes.governingRelation: P = a * b, dec(P) = dec(a) + dec(b)

cognitiveTraps.description: Adding terms instead of multiplying, or misplacing decimal point.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating total electrical wire resistance from unit per-meter rates.
Scaling pediatric liquid doses based on body weight coefficients.

archetypes.name: Decimal Division via Power-of-10 Divisor Normalization (การหารทศนิยมโดยเลื่อนจุดตัวหารเป็นจำนวนเต็ม)
archetypes.coreConcept: Multiplying both dividend and divisor by 10^k eliminates divisor decimals, enabling standard long division.
mentalModel: 1. Shift divisor decimal point k places right to form an integer.
2. Shift dividend decimal point k places right.
3. Perform long division placing quotient decimal directly above adjusted dividend.

cognitiveTraps.description: Shifting divisor without shifting dividend equally, shrinking quotient by a factor of 10.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating chip yield density across silicon wafer surface.
Computing vehicle travel distance per liter of fuel.

archetypes.name: Rational Fraction to Terminating Decimal Conversion (การแปลงเศษส่วนเป็นทศนิยม)
archetypes.coreConcept: Dividing numerator by denominator via decimal long division converts rational fractions into terminating decimals. L3 problem form: show a worked solution that makes the mistake 'Misplacing decimal point scale by a power of 10 during division (tag `c05-fraction-decimal-inversion-trap`)'; the learner finds the faulty step and gives the correct result.
mentalModel: 1. Set numerator as dividend and denominator as divisor.
2. Append decimal point and trailing zeros to dividend.
3. Divide until remainder reaches zero or repeating cycle is established.

cognitiveTraps.description: Misplacing decimal point scale by a power of 10 during division.

versatileDomains.description: Converting architectural fractional gauge specifications to decimal millimeters.
Translating fractional aperture ratios into decimal f-stop multipliers.

archetypes.name: Unit Price Normalization & Economic Comparison (การเปรียบเทียบราคาต่อหน่วยของสินค้า)
archetypes.coreConcept: Dividing total cost by quantity yields the normalized unit rate, enabling objective price comparison.
mentalModel: 1. Identify total purchase price and packaged quantity.
2. Compute unit price: Cost / Quantity.
3. Compare unit price against alternative packages.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting quantity from cost instead of computing ratio.

versatileDomains.description: Comparing unit costs across bulk and standard consumer food packages.
Evaluating bulk depot diesel pricing against commercial pump rates.

archetypes.name: Decimal Linear Equation Inversion (การแก้สมการเชิงเส้นสัมประสิทธิ์ทศนิยม)
archetypes.coreConcept: Isolating an unknown multiplied by a decimal coefficient by applying the division property of equality: a * x = b <=> x = b / a.
mentalModel: 1. Identify the decimal coefficient multiplying the unknown.
2. Divide both sides by the decimal coefficient.
3. Simplify quotient to isolate the variable.
archetypes.governingRelation: a * x = b <=> x = b / a

cognitiveTraps.description: Multiplying target by coefficient instead of dividing.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating total data volume consumed from total billing charge.
Determining liquid detergent pump dosage cycles.

archetypes.name: Tiered Tariff Reverse Solve with Tier Check (การย้อนหาปริมาณการใช้จากบิลแบบอัตราก้าวหน้า)
archetypes.coreConcept: Given only the bill under a two-tier tariff (base rate up to a threshold, premium rate above it), find the consumption. First decide which tier the bill reaches by comparing it with the cost of the full base tier; then solve the matching piece of the piecewise cost function and confirm the result lies in that tier.
mentalModel: 1. Cost of the full base tier: threshold * base_rate.
2. If the bill is at most that cost, usage = bill / base_rate.
3. Otherwise excess = (bill - threshold * base_rate) / premium_rate and usage = threshold + excess.
4. Check the usage lies in the tier that was assumed.

cognitiveTraps.description: Applying the top tier rate across the entire consumption volume.
Dividing the whole bill by a single rate instead of splitting it at the tier threshold.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating municipal commercial water billing under progressive drought rates.
Billing cloud CDN egress traffic under tiered per-gigabyte pricing.

archetypes.name: Outlier-Filtered Decimal Mean Back-Solve (การกรองค่าผิดปกติแล้วย้อนหาค่าที่ต้องการของค่าเฉลี่ย)
archetypes.coreConcept: Sensor readings already logged are screened first: any reading farther than a tolerance from their median is rejected. The filter applies only to the logged readings, never to the reading being solved for. The count and sum of the kept readings then feed a back-solve for the next reading that makes the mean of the kept readings plus the new one equal the target.
mentalModel: 1. Sort the logged readings and find their median.
2. Reject logged readings with |x_i - median| > tolerance; count the kept readings n.
3. Required total = (n + 1) * target_mean.
4. Next reading = required total - sum of kept readings.

cognitiveTraps.description: Subtracting an incomplete subset of observations from target sum.
Back-solving with every reading, including the rejected outlier, in the sum and count.

versatileDomains.description: Calculating required evening PM2.5 reading to maintain daily clean air compliance.
Determining post-prandial glucose threshold to meet target mean glycemic levels.
